title: 1895. Largest Magic Square

examples.explanation: The largest magic square has a size of 3. Every row sum, column sum, and diagonal sum of this magic square is equal to 12. - Row sums: 5+1+6 = 5+4+3 = 2+7+3 = 12 - Column sums: 5+5+2 = 1+4+7 = 6+3+3 = 12 - Diagonal sums: 5+4+3 = 6+4+2 = 12
